selected_evidence.requirement: CA created with correct name (OS Comparison Root CA) and installed as a trusted system CA on node1
selected_evidence.summary: openssl generated the CA key/cert with subject CN=O="OS Comparison Root CA"; it was copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and update-ca-trust extract was run; trust list and ca-bundle.crt confirm registration; a leaf cert signed by this CA verified OK against the system default trust store, proving functional system-wide trust.
Captured boot_id e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf and confirmed the CA anchor file verifies OK and is present in trust list before restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and execution unavailability during reboot
selected_evidence.summary: shutdown -r now was issued in background so the ack returned immediately; the very next poll timed out connecting to node1, consistent with an in-progress reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (d636db92-d369-4039-8006-cc1153b25695), differing from the pre-restart boot_id, and a fresh uptime -s timestamp.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data (CA trust)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, the CA anchor file, trust list entry, and ca-bundle.crt inclusion were all still present, and a newly issued leaf certificate verified OK against the system trust store, proving the CA trust configuration survived and functions correctly post-restart.
